+#!/bin/sh
+#
+# Script to locally run britney1 and britney2 for Ubuntu
+#
+# You can pass it additional options for britney1 such a
+#
+#   hints_git    To download hints
+#   blocks       To download block bugs
+#   excuse_bugs  To download bugs labelled excuses
+#
+# Determine our countainer run time
+cr=docker
+if command -v podman >/dev/null; then
+    cr=podman
+fi
+
+# Disable ADT, you could also set it to dry-run
+sed 's#ADT_ENABLE.*=.*yes.*#ADT_ENABLE = no#' britney.conf -i
+
+# Create and/or update the mirror
+mkdir -p dists output
+for src in rsync://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/ rsync://ports.ubuntu.com/ubuntu-ports/; do
+    rsync -aP  "$src/dists/$(distro-info --devel)*" dists/  --exclude=by-hash --include="*/"  --include=Release --include='Packages.gz' --include='Sources.gz' --exclude="*"
+done
+
+# Build a image to run britney in
+# This is convenient due to layer caching, if the files are up-to-date there is nothing to do
+$cr build -f - --tag britney << EOF
+TAG britney
+FROM ubuntu:noble
+ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
+
+# Install the britney dependencies
+RUN apt update && apt install git brz procmail python3-apt python3-yaml rsync distro-info -y
+
+# Create the necessary directories for britney1 to run britney2
+RUN mkdir -p /home/ubuntu-archive/proposed-migration/code/b{1,2} && \
+    mkdir -p /home/ubuntu-archive/mirror && \
+    mkdir -p /home/ubuntu-archive/proposed-migration/data/$(distro-info --devel)-proposed/state && \
+    mkdir -p /home/ubuntu-archive/proposed-migration/data/$(distro-info --devel)/state && \
+    mkdir -p /home/ubuntu-archive/proposed-migration/var/lock && \
+    mkdir -p /home/ubuntu-archive/proposed-migration/var/data
+
+# Needs to be readable but is not used
+RUN touch /home/ubuntu-archive/proposed-migration/amqp-password.txt
+# This contains the list of block bugs, but we don't want block bugs, so skip them
+RUN touch /home/ubuntu-archive/proposed-migration/data/$(distro-info --devel)-proposed/Blocks
+
+# For some reason this is a symlink that I can't quite figure out
+RUN ln -s ../data /home/ubuntu-archive/proposed-migration/var/data-b2
+
+WORKDIR /home/ubuntu-archive/proposed-migration
+
+# Add hints_git 'blocks' and 'excuse_bugs' if you have the time
+ENTRYPOINT ["/home/ubuntu-archive/proposed-migration/code/b1/britney" ,"pkglists", "run"]
+EOF
+
+# Run the image
+$cr run -v ../britney1-ubuntu:/home/ubuntu-archive/proposed-migration/code/b1 \
+                                                          -v .:/home/ubuntu-archive/proposed-migration/code/b2 \
+                                                          -v $PWD/dists:/home/ubuntu-archive/mirror/ubuntu/dists \
+                                                          -v $PWD/output:/home/ubuntu-archive/proposed-migration/output \
+                                                          --rm -it britney "$@"
